note: Lock mtime > 10 s deleted and taken. Bvn/QSn = 1e4. If stat(t) && Date.now() - st.mtimeMs > Bvn the locker rm's the lock dir and the next loop mkdir takes it. A save slower than 10 s invites a concurrent writer. On a loaded machine with a 215 KB / 334-key config that window is not large.
rule: if st && Date.now() - st.mtimeMs > Bvn → rm lock dir and take over
